end.summary: Practised top, front and side views of cubes, cones, cylinders and bottles.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised identifying how solids look from different viewing places. They matched shown views to objects in all four attempts and described a cone as a triangle from the side and a cylinder as a rectangle. They mixed up the object’s full shape with only the visible face, and this was not corrected by the last related response. At home, use a cup or box and ask Reyansh to draw what is visible from above, in front, and from the side.
